title: Blacks Camp

services.name: Fishing charter
services.desc: Blacks Camp was originally founded as a place where families could get away from the stress of everyday life, with a primary focus on fishing. Over the years, our services and accommodations have changed, but our dedication to helping our guests have a fun fishing experience hasn’t. To help with this goal, we provide a number of services and amenities to make your fishing trip a success. At Blacks Camp, you’ll have access to both Lake Moultrie and Lake Marion fishing opportunities as well as the Diversion Canal. Combined, that’s just under 200,000 acres of surface area.
